segments.outcome: The one-hour wrapper timed out after all width, depth, and total-height models plus kinetic-energy Linear Ridge were checkpointed. The child process continued briefly after the wrapper ended.

The responsive child process continued kinetic-energy Polynomial Ridge but exited before that model checkpoint was written. Exact detached wall time was not available from the expired wrapper, so it is not fabricated.
Reused all compatible checkpoints, completed kinetic-energy Polynomial Ridge, six kinetic-energy GP configurations, Method C, figures, tables, and the preliminary validation dashboard.
Reused every scientific checkpoint and added the explicit Q10 pipeline handoff; no model was refitted.

end_to_end_elapsed_note: From the observed initial process start to the first complete summary, elapsed wall time was approximately 4739 seconds. This includes the detached continuation and the resume; it is reported as approximate because the original process start timestamp was available only to whole seconds.
interpretation: runtime_summary.json reports only the current invocation. This history preserves the long checkpointed execution boundary so a short cached refresh is not misreported as the full scientific runtime.
